```go
func (c *Cache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (interface{}, error) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    entry, ok := c.data[key]
    if ok && time.Now().Before(entry.ExpiresAt) && !entry.Loading {
        atomic.AddInt64(&c.stats.Hits, 1)
        value := entry.Value
        c.mu.Unlock()
        return value, nil
    }

}

func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{...}
}
```

Use `sync.RWMutex` for reads, `atomic` for stats, `sync.WaitGroup` for `GetMulti()`, and hold the lock during cleanup iteration.
